tools.name: describe_forms
tools.description: List the fields of the forms on this page (name, type, label, whether required), so the right values can be prepared before filling anything in.

tools.name: fill_lead_form
tools.description: Fill visible form fields on this page by field name. Does NOT submit the form — the visitor reviews the values and presses the button themselves. Call describe_forms first to learn the field names.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read the current page of this site as markdown — the title, description, canonical url, body text and, when the page sells something, its offers with prices. Prefer this over scraping the rendered HTML.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: List the products sold ON THIS PAGE with their price and currency. This site publishes no catalog of the whole account — a page shows only what it sells, and a page that sells nothing returns nothing.

tools.name: list_site_pages
tools.description: List every published page of this site with a one-line summary of each, read from the site's /llms.txt index. Use it to find the right page before reading one.

tools.name: show_checkout
tools.description: Scroll the checkout form on this page into view and focus it. Does not pay for anything and does not submit anything.
